title.en: Find VXLAN packets in the capture

why.en: VXLAN uses UDP port 4789, and Wireshark decodes the inner Ethernet frame for you.
why.hinglish: VXLAN UDP port 4789 use karta hai, aur Wireshark inner Ethernet frame ko khud decode kar deta hai.

expect.en: Each packet shows outer Ethernet/IP/UDP, a VXLAN layer with the VNI, then the inner Ethernet and IP. Values differ in your copy.
expect.hinglish: Har packet mein outer Ethernet/IP/UDP, VNI wali VXLAN layer, phir inner Ethernet aur IP dikhta hai. Tumhari copy mein values alag ho sakti hain.

why.en: The VNI is what keeps Red and Blue apart even when their inner IPs match.
why.hinglish: VNI hi Red aur Blue ko alag rakhta hai, chahe unke inner IPs same hon.

expect.en: Only the Red tenant's frames remain. Change 10010 to 20020 to see Blue.
expect.hinglish: Sirf Red tenant ke frames bachte hain. Blue dekhne ke liye 10010 ko 20020 kar do.

title.hinglish: Apne interface ka MTU check karo

why.en: VXLAN adds 50 bytes, so MTU is the first thing to check. This is read-only.
why.hinglish: VXLAN 50 bytes jodta hai, isliye sabse pehle MTU check karte hain. Yeh sirf read-only hai.

expect.en: A list of interfaces with their MTU, usually 1500 for Ethernet and Wi-Fi. It varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: Interfaces ki list unke MTU ke saath, Ethernet aur Wi-Fi ke liye aksar 1500. Yeh machine ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

title.en: Find the largest packet that fits
title.hinglish: Sabse bada packet jo fit ho dhoondo

why.en: Pinging with the Don't Fragment flag shows where a size limit starts, the same way the MTU black hole appears.
why.hinglish: Don't Fragment flag ke saath ping karne se dikhta hai ki size limit kahan se shuru hoti hai, bilkul MTU black hole jaisa.

expect.en: On a normal 1500 MTU path 1472 succeeds; 1473 or more fails with “needs to be fragmented”. On macOS use -D instead of -M do. Results vary by network.
expect.hinglish: Normal 1500 MTU path par 1472 chal jaata hai; 1473 ya usse zyada “needs to be fragmented” ke saath fail hota hai. macOS par -M do ki jagah -D use karo. Results network ke hisaab se alag hote hain.
